text:
marta: heads-up  high-value decline in today's autopay: NovaCare $52,400 declined. Gateway tag = expired_card. Putting this in the 'manual review' queue.

billing-bot: autopay-batch 2026-03-14T09:00Z summary: attempts=410, declines=9, total_declines=103200, top_decline=NovaCare:$52400, decline_reasons=[expired_card, insufficient_funds].

aj: I'll run an immediate retry (t+0) and a t+1hr. If still fails, trigger dunning_1 and mark >$10k for sales outreach.

laura: for >$25k we should offer a one-click wire link in the dunning email. Can billing produce a secure link we can include?

jess: yes on the wire link. Also require customers to attach proof of payment (SWIFT/confirmation) before we reconcile. I can draft the 'how to wire' note with our account details + reference format.

marta: also add an ACH micro-deposit flow as a lower-friction option. If they opt for ACH, hold autopay until verification completes.

aj: retry jobs submitted: POST /internal/billing/retry {batch:2026-03-14-09, strategy:immediate_then_1h}.

billing-bot: scheduled actions: dunning_1 (24h), dunning_2 (72h), escalate_to_sales_for_accounts_over_10k=true.

laura: can we surface contact owner in the email so they know who to reply to? saves time.

jess: drafted wire instructions and sample email. I'll drop in the shared drive and ping sales to review.

marta: ok team: 1) aj run retries (in progress), 2) jess publish wire template (in progress), 3) laura add secure wire link to dunning email (assigned), 4) billing-bot queue dunning and flag >$10k for sales. Will update when NovaCare confirms.
